entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this piece of garbage VeloBand you sold me. It doesn't work.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. I can definitely look into this for you. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a technical fault! The pulse reading is a complete joke. It's wildly inaccurate. Look, I don't have time for twenty questions. I just want my money back. This thing is useless.

I understand your frustration completely. An inaccurate pulse reading is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I might be able to help you fix it right now, or I can transfer you to our technical support team. They're experts with the new pulse models.

No! I told you, I don't have time for this nonsense! I'm not your IT guy. I bought a product that was supposed to work. It's garbage. I want a refund! Are you going to process my return or do I need to speak to your manager and tell everyone on the internet how VeloFit sells broken equipment?

No, that won't be necessary at all, I assure you I can handle this for you. Let me just pull up your account and review the policy. I see you're one of our VIP members and we certainly appreciate your business. One moment.

Okay, I have your details here. I see you received the band 43 days ago. Let me just check our knowledge base... yes, according to our policy, you're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you right now.
So, a full refund? No games?

Yes, a full refund to your original payment method. I've just approved the return in our system. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label as we speak. You can just put the device back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed.
Fine. Make sure that email actually shows up.

It was just sent from my system, you should have it within the next 5 minutes. I've noted the reason as defective on the account. I do apologize again for the trouble you've had. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better rest of your day.
